lgpd.art11: Sensitive data: the photo used for the 3D avatar is biometric and requires specific, highlighted consent.
lgpd.art18iii: Right to correction: fix incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
lgpd.art18v: Portability and access: download a full copy of your data in an open format.
lgpd.art18vi: Erasure: request deletion of your personal data.
lgpd.art46: Security: measures that protect your account from unauthorized access.
lgpd.art6iii: Necessity: we collect only the minimum. Your birth date is used only to check the minimum age and is never shown to anyone.
lgpd.art6vi: Transparency: you get information about how your data is processed in your own language.
lgpd.art6viii: Prevention: your profile starts visible only to you (privacy by default).
lgpd.art7i: Consent: this purpose is used only if you turn it on, and you can turn it off whenever you want.
lgpd.art7v: Contract performance: your e-mail is required for your account; changing it requires confirming you own the new address.
lgpd.art8p2: Proof of consent: we keep when, where and under which text version you consented or revoked.
lgpd.art8p5: Revocation: turning a consent off is as easy as turning it on, always right here.
lgpd.art9: Easy access: see what was done with your account and when.
privacy.biometric.grantBody: With your permission, we use the photo you upload only to measure facial features and build your My player 3D figure.
privacy.biometric.grantTitle: Allow your photo to be used for the 3D avatar?
privacy.biometric.point.local: The feature analysis runs in your browser. We store the cropped photo, the reference photos you upload, the texture, the 3D model and the facial metrics and parameters (shape, skin tone and hair) of your digital double.
privacy.biometric.point.purpose: We don't use the photo for anything else or share it with third parties.
privacy.biometric.point.retention: Reference photos are deleted automatically within 180 days, or 30 days after you approve your digital double. You can delete each one sooner.
privacy.biometric.point.revoke: You can revoke it here at any time; photos, texture, model and facial metrics and parameters are deleted right away. Only what you typed in yourself is kept.
privacy.biometric.revokeBody: Your photo, reference photos, face texture, 3D model and the facial metrics and parameters of My player will be deleted. The figure goes back to the default face; only what you typed in yourself is kept.
privacy.biometric.revokedToast: Consent revoked. Photos, 3D model and facial parameters deleted.
